name: The Sunset Fairies
source:
After a world-changing event, the MC will have to live day to day in the company of his nieces.
But that's not all, he will also have to look for the remaining members of his family and form "bonds" with them.​
translation:
一场改变世界的事件发生后，主人公不得不与自己的侄女们相伴，努力过好每一天。
不过，事情并不止于此。他还得寻找其他尚在人世的家人，并与她们建立“羁绊”。
